title: Canavarlar da Kibardır
author: Özlem Fedai Korçak
description: Monsters Are Kind Too! teaches children social values such as politeness, empathy, and respect. It emphasizes how kind and thoughtful monsters can be despite their appearance, teaching children that judging others based on appearance is wrong. The book also introduces fundamental life skills such as effective communication, cooperation, and teamwork.
